title: Costunolide ameliorates MNNG-induced chronic atrophic gastritis through inhibiting oxidative stress and DNA damage via activation of Nrf2.
authors: Wang, Ruixuan; Zhao, Youdong; Zhou, Lei; Lin, Fei; Wan, Meiqi; Gan, Anna; Wu, Bo; Yan, Tingxu; Jia, Ying
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Costunolide通过激活Nrf2抑制氧化应激和DNA损伤治疗慢性萎缩性胃炎，属于疾病药理与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG) is a chronic digestive disease. Modern research has revealed substantial evidence indicating that the progression of CAG is closely linked to the occurrence of oxidative stress-induced DNA damage and apoptosis in the gastric mucosa. Additionally, research has indicated that Costunolide (COS), the primary active compound found in Aucklandiae Radix, a traditional herb, exhibits antioxidant properties. Nevertheless, the therapeutic potential of COS in treating CAG and its molecular targets have not yet been determined. PURPOSE: The objective of this research was to explore the potential gastric mucosal protective effects and mechanisms of COS against N-Methyl-N -nitro-N-nitrosoguanidine (MNNG)-induced CAG. METHODS: Firstly, the MNNG-induced rat CAG model was established in vivo. Occurrence of CAG was detected through macroscopic examination of the stomachs and H&E staining. Additionally, we assessed oxidative stress, DNA damage, and apoptosis using biochemical detection, Western blot, immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence. Then, an in vitro model was developed to induce MNNG-induced damage in GES-1 cells, and the occurrence of cell damage was determined by Hoechst 33,342 staining and flow cytometry. Finally, the key targets of COS for the treatment of CAG were identified through molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and inhibitor ML385. RESULTS: In vivo studies demonstrated that COS promotes the expression of Nrf2 in gastric tissues. This led to an increased expression of SOD, GSH, HO-1, while reducing the production of MDA. Furthermore, COS inhibited DNA damage and apoptosis by suppressing the expression of gammaH2AX and PARP1 in gastric tissues. In vitro studies showed that COS effectively reversed apoptosis induced by MNNG in GES-1 cells. Additionally, COS interacted with Nrf2 to promote its expression. Furthermore, the expression levels of SOD, GSH, and HO-1 were augmented, while the generation of ROS and MDA was diminished. CONCLUSIONS: Our results indicate that COS exhibits therapeutic effects on CAG through the promotion of Nrf2 expression and inhibition of oxidative stress and DNA damage. Therefore, COS has the potential to provide new drugs for the treatment of CAG.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性萎缩性胃炎（chronic atrophic gastritis, CAG）是一种慢性消化系统疾病。现代研究已提供大量证据表明，CAG的进展与胃黏膜中氧化应激诱导的DNA损伤和细胞凋亡的发生密切相关。此外，研究指出，木香（Aucklandiae Radix）中的主要活性化合物木香烃内酯（Costunolide, COS）具有抗氧化特性。然而，COS在治疗CAG中的治疗潜力及其分子靶点尚未确定。目的：本研究旨在探讨COS对N-甲基-N'-硝基-N-亚硝基胍（MNNG）诱导的CAG的潜在胃黏膜保护作用及其机制。方法：首先，在体内建立MNNG诱导的大鼠CAG模型。通过胃部肉眼检查和H&E染色检测CAG的发生。此外，使用生化检测、Western blot、免疫组织化学和免疫荧光评估氧化应激、DNA损伤和细胞凋亡。然后，建立体外模型以诱导GES-1细胞中的MNNG损伤，并通过Hoechst 33,342染色和流式细胞术确定细胞损伤的发生。最后，通过分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和抑制剂ML385鉴定COS治疗CAG的关键靶点。结果：体内研究表明，COS促进胃组织中Nrf2的表达，从而增加SOD、GSH、HO-1的表达，同时减少MDA的产生。此外，COS通过抑制胃组织中gammaH2AX和PARP1的表达来抑制DNA损伤和细胞凋亡。体外研究表明，COS有效逆转MNNG诱导的GES-1细胞凋亡。此外，COS与Nrf2相互作用以促进其表达，同时SOD、GSH和HO-1的表达水平增强，而ROS和MDA的生成减少。结论：我们的结果表明，COS通过促进Nrf2表达并抑制氧化应激和DNA损伤，对CAG表现出治疗作用。因此，COS有潜力为CAG的治疗提供新药物。
